message.projecthero.raven.acquired_hint: Stay calm: your Composure is the thin line under the Dark Energy bar. Tap V to cast your spell, hold V for the Spell Wheel. Double-tap Space to levitate. Hold Shift+V to meditate. Press I for your moves.
message.projecthero.raven.no_room: There's no room for you there
message.projecthero.raven.veil_broken: You step out of the shadows
message.projecthero.raven.detonation_bro: The marks fade: Soul Detonation broken
projecthero.raven.ability.dark_bolt.desc: A fast bolt of black energy: 8 damage, and it bursts in a small purple pop that hits everything else within 2 blocks for 4. While you're Unsettled it drifts off your aim. 8 Dark Energy.
projecthero.raven.ability.soul_shield.de: A purple barrier wraps you for 5 seconds. It absorbs 30 damage (50 in Demonic Ascension, half that in Rage), sends arrows and other projectiles back at whoever shot them, and knocks melee attackers away. If it soaked 20 or more, it bursts when it ends: 8 damage to everything within 4 blocks. 25 Dark Energy, 16 s cooldown.
projecthero.raven.ability.soul_self.desc: Your soul flies out as a great raven of dark energy and you steer it with your look for up to 5 seconds, through walls and creatures. Everything it touches takes 14 damage, Blindness and Slowness. Press Shift+G again to step through into its place; otherwise it flies back to you. Half again as big and strong in Demonic Ascension. 35 Dark Energy, 18 s cooldown.
projecthero.raven.ability.telekinetic_cr: Up to 6 creatures in front of you (10 blocks) are wrapped in dark energy, lifted into the air for 2 seconds and slammed down: 14 damage and a 1 second stun. Bosses aren't lifted; they only take the damage. 30 Dark Energy, 9 s cooldown.
Only in Rage (Composure under 10). For 15 seconds you become a giant cloaked shadow, three times your size, with four red eyes. Three times, tentacles of dark energy grab everything within 12 blocks, lift it and slam it down for 30 damage; players are struck with fear. Afterwards you're drained: calm again, with no Dark Energy. 3 minute cooldown.
projecthero.raven.ability.energy_wave.de: Gather dark energy for a moment, then a wide wave rolls 12 blocks out ahead of you: 12 damage, knockback and Slowness to everything it passes. With mob griefing on it shatters glass and leaves. 30 Dark Energy, 11 s cooldown.
projecthero.raven.ability.demonic_ascens: For 15 seconds your eyes burn white and a purple aura wraps you: everything you cast hits 35% harder and costs 25% less, Dark Energy refills twice as fast, you move 20% faster, the Soul Shield absorbs 50 and your Soul-Self is half again as big and strong. It shakes your Composure (down 20). 40 Dark Energy, 60 s cooldown.
projecthero.raven.ability.cast_spell.des: Tap V to cast the spell you picked on the Spell Wheel. Its icon sits in the V box on your HUD, with its cooldown.
projecthero.raven.ability.spell_wheel.de: Hold V to open a wheel of your ten spells (the game keeps running). Point at one and let go of V to pick it; let go over the middle to keep the one you have. Each slice shows a spell's icon and name; the middle shows the one you point at, with its Dark Energy cost, its cooldown and a few words, and its full description sits next to the wheel.
projecthero.raven.spell.void_vortex.desc: Open a vortex where you look (up to 24 blocks) for 4 seconds. It drags creatures within 7 blocks into it, hurting those caught in it for 3 a second, then explodes for 10. 30 Dark Energy, 15 s cooldown.
projecthero.raven.spell.shadow_binding.d: Black claws rise out of the ground in a 4-block circle where you look (up to 24 blocks): 6 damage, and everything inside is held in place for 3 seconds. Bosses are only slowed. 20 Dark Energy, 12 s cooldown.
Mark every creature within 6 blocks of you. 1.5 seconds later the marks explode: up to 24 damage, more the closer they are to you. Taking 8 or more damage while it counts down breaks it. 40 Dark Energy, 18 s cooldown.
projecthero.raven.spell.soul_devour.desc: A drain beam locks onto the creature you look at (up to 16 blocks) for 3 seconds: 4 damage every half second, and half of what it takes heals you. It breaks if it gets more than 16 blocks away or out of sight. It's a beam, so it can clash with other beams. 35 Dark Energy, 20 s cooldown.
projecthero.raven.spell.debris_storm.des: Tear up 8 nearby blocks into an orbit around you. Tap V again, or left click, to fire them one at a time at your aim: 8 damage each. With mob griefing off they are energy copies and the ground is untouched; with it on the real blocks go back after 10 seconds. 30 Dark Energy, 20 s cooldown.
projecthero.raven.spell.dimensional_rift: Tear a portal where you look, up to 20 blocks away, and step through it. Aimed at a wall, it opens on the other side if there's room for you there. 25 Dark Energy, 12 s cooldown.
projecthero.raven.spell.soul_restoration: Aimed at a squadmate: take up to 10 of their missing health as your own damage and heal them double. Aimed at no one: stand still and channel for 3 seconds to heal 6 hearts and shake off poison, weakness and slowness; it calms you too (Composure +30). Moving or being hit breaks the channel. 45 Dark Energy, 25 s cooldown.
projecthero.raven.spell.telekinetic_pull: Every dropped item within 20 blocks flies to you. If you look at a lever or button it's flipped from where you stand; if you look at a light creature (40 health or less) it's yanked to you. 15 Dark Energy, 8 s cooldown.
projecthero.raven.spell.astral_sanctuary: Raise a 5-block dome of dark energy where you stand for 8 seconds. Projectiles from outside stop at it, hostile creatures can't get in, and you and your squadmates inside take 40% less damage (20% in Rage). 60 Dark Energy, 35 s cooldown.
projecthero.raven.spell.shadow_veil.desc: Melt into shadow for 6 seconds: invisible, silent, and creatures after you lose track of you. Any attack you make ends it. 20 Dark Energy, 20 s cooldown.
screen.projecthero.raven.wheel.hint: Point at a spell and let go of V to pick it. Middle or Esc: keep yours.
projecthero.guide.raven.body: Raven, daughter of Trigon, an empath from Azarath: a magical battlefield controller. Her dark energy lifts, crushes and throws, she slips through shadow, sends out her raven-shaped soul-self, shields herself and her friends, and heals by taking others' pain. Ten spells wait on her Spell Wheel. She must stay calm: unsettled, her magic grows stronger but wild, and when she loses control Trigon's red-eyed side breaks through.
projecthero.guide.raven.traits.body: 30 health and 10% less damage taken. You always fall slowly unless you are flying. Double-tap Space to levitate. Dive into the ground fast (sprinting) and you land kneeling in a ring of dark soul energy.
projecthero.guide.raven.passives.body: Demonic Heritage: magic and supernatural harm (potions, evoker fangs, witches, vexes, wither, lightning, the Warden's boom) hurts you 30% less. Dark Empathy: every creature you kill gives back a heart and 5 Dark Energy. Mystical Awareness: every 8 seconds, hostile creatures within 24 blocks glow through walls for 2 seconds, on your screen only.
projecthero.guide.raven.energy.body: The violet Slab on your HUD, up to 100. It refills 5 a second (10 in Demonic Ascension) and pays for every move and spell. Holding Telekinesis drains it instead.
projecthero.guide.raven.composure.body: The thin Hairline under the Slab, with your state named on the right of the HUD. It starts Calm. Taking damage, casting and hostile mobs around you for a long time push it down; quiet spells bring it back slowly, meditating brings it back fast, and Soul Restoration calms you. Under 40 you are Unsettled: your spells hit 20% harder but run wild (Dark Bolts drift, 1 in 8 wheel spells misfires to a random nearby spot or slips away), and now and then a nearby pane of glass or a lamp cracks (it only really breaks with mob griefing on) or a creature is shoved away. Under 10 is Rage: four red eyes, spells 40% harder, your shields absorb half as much, and Trigon's Wrath unlocks.
projecthero.guide.raven.look.body: Your skin stays your own. Faint dark wisps drift from your hands, thicker while you cast; your eyes glow white while you cast, and at Rage four red eyes open. In Demonic Ascension a purple aura swirls round you.
projecthero.guide.raven.wheel.body: Hold V to open the wheel and point at a spell, then let go to pick it; tap V to cast it. The picked spell's icon sits in your HUD's V box. Five combat spells and five utility spells:
